standard_prerequisites.name: Quasi-coherence of tensor and localisation behaviour, and the etale lifting lemma
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Descent, Proposition descent-proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent (03DX, line 1883) and descent-proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent-functorial (03LC, line 1901), Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-lift-etale-infinitesimal (05YT, line 1886)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supply the identifications on affine etale objects and the etaleness of A(U) -> A(V), which turn U -> Spec(A(U)) into a functor.

core_obligations: Build the functor on the small etale site: for an affine scheme U etale over X, H^1(U_etale, I) = 0 makes I(U) contained in A(U) -> O_X(U) exact, quasi-coherence identifies I(V) with I(U) tensor O_X(V), and the etale lifting lemma shows A(U) -> A(V) is etale; hence U -> U' = Spec(A(U)) is a functor on X_{affine, etale} (proof lines 1866-1891).

Extend it to all of X_etale and control the local models: for a general U in X_etale the restriction to the Zariski site is quasi-coherent with the same square-zero extension, so the scheme-level first order thickening applies and gives U contained in U' with O_{U'} isomorphic to A restricted; the construction agrees with the affine one (proof lines 1892-1906).

Descend to an algebraic space: choose a presentation X = U/R with its etale equivalence relation, apply the functor to get an etale equivalence relation R' => U' in schemes, set X' = U'/R', observe that X -> X' is a first order thickening and that the isomorphism gamma : O_{X'}|_{U_etale} -> A|_{U_etale} is compatible with s and t, so that descent of the sheaf gives the required global isomorphism O_{X'} -> A; finally the general base B is handled by first constructing X' over Z and then giving X' the structure morphism to B by the maps lemma (proof lines 1908-1938).
proof_roadmap: Work over B = S = Spec(Z) and build the functor U -> U' = Spec(A(U)) on affine etale objects (proof lines 1866-1891).
Extend that functor to all etale objects using the scheme-level statement on the Zariski restriction (proof lines 1892-1906).

Descend along a presentation X = U/R to get an algebraic space X' = U'/R' with a first order thickening X contained in X', and glue the isomorphism O_{X'} -> A by descent on the etale site (proof lines 1908-1929).
Handle a general base algebraic space B by constructing X' over Z first and then using the maps lemma to define X' -> B (proof lines 1932-1938).
difficulty_reason: The lemma manufactures a first order thickening X contained in X' of algebraic spaces over B out of a square-zero quasi-coherent ideal extension 0 -> I -> A -> O_X -> 0 of sheaves of f^{-1}O_B-algebras on X_etale (statement lines 1841-1858). The proof is a three-stage descent: it builds the functor U -> Spec(A(U)) on affine etale objects, extends it to all etale objects by comparing with the scheme-level statement on Zariski restrictions, descends along a presentation X = U/R to obtain an algebraic space X' = U'/R', and then glues the isomorphism O_{X'} -> A by descent on the etale site, with the general base B handled by a separate structural step (proof lines 1866-1938). The genuinely non-formal work is the interaction of the local models with the etale equivalence relation. The claim is H2.
